summaryZh: 久保田在2026年农场进步展上推出WorkSmart科技计划，首款产品为自动转向系统，提供6-8英寸和1英寸两种精度等级，售价6000美元，支持改装和原厂安装。同时新增远程信息处理功能，可追踪机器数据、燃油油位、地理围栏和防盗监控。该计划强调在保持久保田简单可靠传统的同时，引入经过验证的投资回报技术，而非单纯追求技术先进性。
featuredReason: 久保田作为全球领先农机品牌，其WorkSmart计划以6000美元亲民价格和"实用而非炫技"理念切入精准农业市场，对智慧畜牧行业从业者理解农机技术商业化路径和性价比策略具有参考价值。

Kubota launches WorkSmart to bring practical tech to farmers

Farm Progress Show: The new tech initiative delivers autosteer precision and telematic monitoring while maintaining Kubota’s signature reliability and simplicity.

Andy Castillo,Editor of Farm Equipment and Machinery,Farm ProgressSeptember 2, 2026

schedule2 Min Read

Kubota’s new WorkSmart autosteer system offers farmers precision guidance with 1-inch accuracy, available as a retrofit or factory install across the company’s equipment lineup for $6,000. Pictured, a customer test-drives the autosteer system at the 2026 Farm Progress Show in Boone, Iowa. Andy Castillo 

Subscribe to Farm Progress AGTech — our free, twice-weekly newsletter delivering the latest innovations, emerging technologies and expert insights to your inbox.

Kubota has always prioritized reliable simplicity. For a while, that meant little technology. That’s changing with the introduction of WorkSmart, Kubota’s new tech initiative that brings the latest factory-installed and retrofitted advancements to its orange machinery platform.

“We’re not just going after technology for technology’s sake,” said Brent Newkirk, WorkSmart’s product manager. “What pieces of technology can we add to our equipment to help our customers, to help our users be more successful? We don’t want to change the mentality of simple and reliable. Our customers love it. We’ve been successful at it.”

Autosteer is the first WorkSmart product launched into an ag machinery market that’s quickly becoming more digital. Today’s farmers are as proficient with computers as they are with diesel motors. The new autosteer precision guidance system is available for retrofit or factory install across Kubota’s product lineup.

Related:Favorite products from FPS26

Each autosteer system is engineered for the specific model it is installed on. Via satellite connection, a subscription-free version is accurate on repeatable passes of 6 to 8 inches. A premium tier delivers 1-inch accuracy. Both system options integrate seamlessly with Kubota’s intuitive user interface and maintain consistent accuracy throughout field operations. The unit may be sold, installed, serviced and warranted and financed through a single dealership.

“At your command, the machine holds the line, so you stay sharp, cover more ground and still get home with something left for the people who matter most,” said Austin Hawkins, senior manager for technology sales and marketing at Kubota North America.

Proven ROI

Priced at $6,000, it’s installed by attaching bolt-on hardware for older machines or connecting to newer equipment’s internal operating system. Newkirk acknowledged that Kubota is late to the tech marketplace, but noted that what farmers want is well established. The tech released through WorkSmart’s technology will be immediately useful, with proven investment return.

“We’re being very cognizant, cautious. Very conscious about the direction we go in, of bringing pieces of technology that our customers can say, ‘You know what? I didn’t think I needed that necessarily. But now I can’t live without it,’” he said. “What works really well in the lab or in certain environments might not scale properly out to the broad customer.”

Related:2027 Farm Progress Show returns to Decatur, Ill.

Internal telematic capability is another new feature offered by WorkSmart. Kubota operators can now access and track machine data including engine hours, fuel level, geo-fencing capabilities, machine geolocation and theft prevention monitoring. The capability is only for orange-colored machines, with API integration that can connect to other telematic software platforms.

“We’re not trying to send an ATV to the moon. We’re trying to make it more user-friendly, bring options and features that customers will use every day,” Newkirk said.

About the Author

Andy Castillo

Editor of Farm Equipment and Machinery, Farm Progress

Andy Castillo started his career in journalism about a decade ago as a television news cameraperson and producer before transitioning to a regional newspaper covering western Massachusetts, where he wrote about local farming. Between military deployments with the Air Force and covering the news, he earned an MFA in creative nonfiction writing from Bay Path University, building on the English degree he earned from the University of Massachusetts Amherst. In his role at Farm Progress, Castillo covers agricultural technology, new machinery and the constantly evolving farm equipment marketplace.

Castillo splits his time between the open road and western Massachusetts with his wife, Brianna, a travel nurse who specializes in pediatric oncology, and their rescue pup, Rio. When not attending farm shows, Castillo enjoys playing music, snowboarding, writing, cooking and restoring their 1920 craftsman bungalow. You can find Castillo at farm machinery shows across the country.

translationZh:
久保田一直将可靠的简洁性放在首位。有一段时间，这意味着技术含量不高。随着WorkSmart的推出，这一情况正在改变。WorkSmart是久保田新的科技计划，将最新的原厂安装和改装升级引入其橙色机械平台。

“我们不仅仅是为了技术而追求技术，”WorkSmart产品经理布伦特·纽柯克说。“我们能在设备上增加哪些技术来帮助我们的客户、帮助我们的用户更成功？我们不想改变简单可靠的理念。我们的客户喜欢这一点。我们在这方面一直很成功。”

自动转向是WorkSmart在正迅速变得更加数字化的农机市场中推出的首款产品。如今的农民对计算机的熟练程度不亚于对柴油发动机。新的自动转向精准导航系统可在久保田全线产品上提供改装或原厂安装。

每个自动转向系统都针对其安装的特定型号进行了工程设计。通过卫星连接，无订阅版本在可重复作业中的精度为6至8英寸。高级版本提供1英寸精度。两种系统选项都能与久保田直观的用户界面无缝集成，并在田间作业中保持一致的精度。该设备可通过单一经销商进行销售、安装、维修、保修和融资。

“听从您的指令，机器保持路线，这样您就能保持敏锐，覆盖更多土地，并且仍然能带着精力回家，留给最重要的人，”久保田北美技术销售与营销高级经理奥斯汀·霍金斯说。

**经过验证的投资回报**

售价6000美元，安装方式是为旧机器加装螺栓固定硬件，或连接到新设备的内部操作系统。纽柯克承认久保田进入科技市场较晚，但指出农民的需求已经很明确。通过WorkSmart技术发布的技术将立即可用，并具有经过验证的投资回报。

“我们非常清醒和谨慎。对于我们要引入的技术方向非常自觉，这些技术要让我们的客户能说：‘你知道吗？我原来不认为我需要这个。但现在我离不开它了，’”他说。“在实验室或某些环境中效果很好的东西，可能无法大规模适配广泛的客户群。”

内部远程信息处理能力是WorkSmart提供的另一项新功能。久保田操作员现在可以访问和跟踪机器数据，包括发动机工时、燃油油位、地理围栏功能、机器地理位置和防盗监控。该功能仅适用于橙色机器，并提供API集成，可连接到其他远程信息处理软件平台。

“我们不是试图把一辆全地形车送上月球。我们是试图让它更用户友好，带来客户每天都会使用的选项和功能，”纽柯克说。
